name: baidu-search-keyword
objective: Open Baidu, search for a supplied keyword, and capture the visible result state.

keyword.description: Keyword entered in the Baidu search field

toolGraph.verification: Snapshot contains the Baidu search surface
toolGraph.fallback: Stop and report the navigation error

toolGraph.verification: Search field contains the supplied keyword
toolGraph.fallback: Inspect current page state and update the recorded CSS selector

toolGraph.verification: Visible page content changes to search results
toolGraph.fallback: Inspect current page state and update the recorded CSS selector

toolGraph.verification: Snapshot contains result content for the keyword
toolGraph.fallback: Capture a screenshot and report the unexpected state

toolGraph.verification: A non-empty screenshot artifact is produced
toolGraph.fallback: Return the text snapshot and report screenshot failure
Ask the host to cancel the browser session
